notes.title: Surgeon Simulator adding alien patients to iPad version
notes.notes: If there haven't been enough human patients to operate on and/or butcher horribly, Bossa Studios is about to offer some more subjects for the operating table. Surgeon Simulator 2013 on iPad will soon receive a free update that features alien patients, because aliens have parts that need removing, too.
